versions.content: If J1939Tp Rx RetrySupport is enabled, when a sequence error occurs during reception, the J1939Tp module shall , after the last TP.DT message of the block was received, send a TP.CM_CTS frame requesting the package s that follow the last correctly received package of the current block .
